projects.title: Digi Scanner
projects.subtitle: React Exam-Scanning App
description: Built the full student and staff scan flow in React, Vite, and Redux Toolkit (capture to submit).
Ran OpenCV document detection in a Web Worker so the camera UI stays smooth.
Added face login and MediaPipe liveness checks (hand pose and head-yaw).
Stored scanned booklets in IndexedDB with iOS-safe, per-student persistence.
Submitted pages via signed URLs with retry/resume, token refresh, and Docker deploy.

projects.title: Digi Assess
projects.subtitle: Scan-Based Manual Evaluation
description: Built evaluation flows so graders mark scanned answer booklets student-by-student.
Developed student list UI with search, pagination, and status filters.
Implemented booklet evaluation with mark entry, annotations, and unsaved-change handling.
Integrated APIs for questions, marks import, evaluation config, and activity history.
